text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaah! Top Road, show us a victory for
the ages!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: You're the gutsiest and most amazing runner I know, Doto! You can definitely, definitely win this!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
It's all you, Opera O! This racetrack is all
yours to
reign over!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
Cafe! Take down the older runners! Run
for
Tachyon's sake too! You're the
future!

text_block_list.name: Spectator E
text_block_list.text:
With a lineup like this, I wonder how Air
Shakur is
gonna fare.

text_block_list.name: Spectator F
text_block_list.text:
She may be the best in her year, but
that's not
saying much since she's the
only one who shows
any promise. Not
counting Digitan, that is.

text_block_list.name: Spectator G
text_block_list.text:
Shakur... You can win this. You're the
best...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Wow, so this is the Arima Kinen! It feels
like a
festival!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The energy's to be expected,
considering how
emotionally invested
both the racers and the
spectators are in
this race.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You have the makings of a great racer
too, Fine...
Who knows? Maybe you'll be
on the track instead
of in the stands
next year.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: You really think so?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Running in a race as lively as this would
make for
a wonderful memory.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm... That's assuming you could
leave it as
just a memory, but it's a nice
thought, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'm only here to watch Air Shakur. I have
to
capture every last one of her feelings.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hehe, well now. Let's see how she does.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...They're so freakin' loud. I can't believe
I can
hear them from here.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Why? It's probably just garbage.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
choice_data_list: それを確かめるんだよ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur slowly closes her eyes, pricks
up her
ears, and listens to the voices
around her.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(The noise is unravelling into separate
threads... I
hear anticipation, doubt,
passion, and ire in their
voices...)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: (Ah, I see... So that's all it was.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: None of it's worth my time.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
There's no point wastin' energy even
shutting it
out. None of it means
anything to me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The annoyance and tension in her are
gone, and
Air Shakur looks completely
at ease. I guess she's
found her resolve.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's made it this far by standing her
ground and
facing reality.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: You've got somethin' to say, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Well, spit it out. I'm all ears.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Not that.
choice_data_list: ……やりたいことを貫いてきて

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
That's what I gotta do anyway. I'm askin'
what you
want.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: What do you want me to do?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If dreams alone could change anything,
don't you
think that would've happened
already?!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I bet you think everything I've done so
far has
been for naught and that I should
just give up and
accept my fate.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I need to be so undeniably astounding
that even
the thickest idiot'll know who's
standing on top.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I know exactly what I want her to do.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hah.
choice_data_list: 貴方が本物だってこと

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Shut it, Captain Obvious.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I was gonna do that anyways.
